# 05 — Design tokens and visual system

**Milestone:** M1 · **Status:** Draft for approval · **Source of truth:** `design/tokens/proxyflow.tokens.json` (W3C Design Tokens format) · **Contrast proof:** `design/tokens/contrast-report.md` (generated by `design/tools/check_contrast.py`, 0 failing pairs)

## 1. Brand inputs (from the brief) and what we derived

| Input | Value | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| Navy | `#14243A` | Text and icons on light surfaces; secondary role |
| Teal | `#20B8A5` | **Fill only** in the light theme (big Connect button, connected ring, accents) with navy content (6.30:1). Never text or thin lines on light surfaces (2.33:1 on the light background fails AA). Primary colour in the dark theme (7.21:1 on `#101820`). |
| Light background | `#F6F8FB` | `background` (light) |
| Dark background | `#101820` | `background` (dark) |
| Teal 700 (derived) | `#157A6D` | Same hue as brand teal, darker: light-theme `primary` for text, links, buttons (4.89:1 on the light background, 5.20:1 under white text) |

## 2. Colour roles (Material 3 `ColorScheme` names)

| Role | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|
| primary / onPrimary | `#157A6D` / `#FFFFFF` | `#20B8A5` / `#101820` |
| primaryContainer / onPrimaryContainer | `#C7F0EA` / `#0B2F2A` | `#0E4F47` / `#C7F0EA` |
| secondary / onSecondary | `#14243A` / `#FFFFFF` | `#B9C8DB` / `#14243A` |
| secondaryContainer / onSecondaryContainer | `#DCE3EE` / `#14243A` | `#2A3B52` / `#DCE3EE` |
| background / onBackground | `#F6F8FB` / `#14243A` | `#101820` / `#E3E9F0` |
| surface / onSurface | `#FFFFFF` / `#14243A` | `#16212C` / `#E3E9F0` |
| surfaceVariant / onSurfaceVariant | `#E6EBF1` / `#465569` | `#223040` / `#A9B6C6` |
| outline / outlineVariant | `#6E7D92` / `#C9D1DC` | `#7F8EA1` / `#344354` |
| error / onError | `#B3261E` / `#FFFFFF` | `#F2B8B5` / `#601410` |
| errorContainer / onErrorContainer | `#F9DEDC` / `#410E0B` | `#8C1D18` / `#F9DEDC` |
| warning / onWarning *(custom)* | `#8A5300` / `#FFFFFF` | `#F5C26B` / `#3D2600` |
| warningContainer / onWarningContainer *(custom)* | `#FFE2B8` / `#3D2600` | `#5A3D00` / `#FFE2B8` |
| accentFill / onAccentFill *(custom)* | `#20B8A5` / `#14243A` | `#20B8A5` / `#101820` |

Status colours (always paired with an icon and a text label — never colour alone):

| Status | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|
| Connected | `#157A6D` | `#20B8A5` |
| Connecting / Reconnecting | `#8A5300` | `#F5C26B` |
| Off | `#465569` | `#A9B6C6` |
| Error | `#B3261E` | `#F2B8B5` |

Dynamic colour (Material You) is **off**: status colours carry meaning and must stay predictable.

## 3. Typography

Roboto (system default on most devices; no bundled font file needed), Roboto Mono / system monospace for addresses, codes and timers.

| Token | Size / line height / weight | Use |
|---|---|---|
| displaySmall | 36 / 44 / 400 | rarely; large numbers |
| headlineSmall | 24 / 32 / 400 | dialog titles |
| titleLarge | 22 / 28 / 500 | top-bar titles |
| titleMedium | 16 / 24 / 500 | card titles, status line |
| bodyLarge | 16 / 24 / 400 | primary body text |
| bodyMedium | 14 / 20 / 400 | secondary text |
| labelLarge | 14 / 20 / 500 | buttons |
| labelMedium | 12 / 16 / 500 | chips, navigation labels, section labels |
| monoSmall | 12 / 16 / 400 (monospace) | log lines, `host:port`, error codes |

All sizes in `sp`; layouts verified at 200 % font scale in M9.

## 4. Shape, spacing, motion

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| radius.small | 8 dp | chips, tags |
| radius.medium | 12 dp | stat tiles, icon tiles, banners |
| radius.large | 16 dp | cards, FAB |
| radius.extraLarge | 28 dp | dialogs, bottom sheets (top corners) |
| radius.full | pill | buttons, navigation indicator, switches |
| spacing | 4 / 8 / 16 / 24 / 32 dp | 4 dp grid; 16 dp screen gutter |
| minTouchTarget | 48 dp | every tappable element |
| motion.statusTransition | 250 ms | ring/colour changes; disabled when "Remove animations" is on |

## 5. Iconography and brand assets

- All icons in the design file are original 24 dp stroke icons drawn for ProxyFlow (shield-with-arrow logo mark, power, profiles, logs, gear, lock, key, alert, block, refresh). Material Symbols (Apache-2.0) may replace them in code; no icons, illustrations or screenshots from other proxy apps are used anywhere.
- The launcher icon is the shield-with-arrow mark in navy on a teal background (adaptive icon, monochrome layer for Android 13 themed icons) — to be produced in M2 and trademark-checked before M11.

## 6. Compose mapping (for M2)

```kotlin
// core/ui/theme/Color.kt — generated from proxyflow.tokens.json in M2 (script, not hand-copied)
val LightColors = lightColorScheme(
    primary = Color(0xFF157A6D), onPrimary = Color.White,
    primaryContainer = Color(0xFFC7F0EA), onPrimaryContainer = Color(0xFF0B2F2A),
    secondary = Color(0xFF14243A), onSecondary = Color.White,
    background = Color(0xFFF6F8FB), onBackground = Color(0xFF14243A),
    surface = Color.White, onSurface = Color(0xFF14243A),
    surfaceVariant = Color(0xFFE6EBF1), onSurfaceVariant = Color(0xFF465569),
    outline = Color(0xFF6E7D92), outlineVariant = Color(0xFFC9D1DC),
    error = Color(0xFFB3261E), errorContainer = Color(0xFFF9DEDC), onErrorContainer = Color(0xFF410E0B),
)
// warning, accentFill and status colours live in a small `ProxyFlowColors` CompositionLocal.
```

M2 adds a unit test that recomputes every pair in `contrast-report.md` from the generated Kotlin so the code cannot drift from the tokens.

## 7. Design file

- **Interactive canvas:** "ProxyFlow V1 — Screens & Error States" — 43 boards (36 clickable phone screens, the error catalogue, the notification and Quick Settings sheets, and four dark-theme boards). Link in `M1-acceptance-report.md`.
- **Repository copy:** `design/screens/*.dc.html` + `canvas.json` (the same boards; they render inside the design canvas, which supplies `support.js`).
- App screens use only the tokens above; the dark boards (B2, B4, B6a, C2) demonstrate the dark mapping. The one exception is the grey `#DCE3EB` backdrop of B10 and B11, which imitates Android's own notification shade, not ProxyFlow UI.
